Enclosing class:
SharedGameTestSupport
static final class SharedGameTestSupport.RecordingServerPlayer extends net.minecraft.server.level.ServerPlayer
A server player outside the player list that records the messages the server would display to it. Its game connection has no network channel, so packets sent to it, such as inventory slot updates, are queued and never delivered.
